end.parentNote: Ishita practised drawing rows and columns to show how square and triangular patterns grow. They explained that a new row and column share one corner, so the shared dot must not be counted twice; this mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask them to draw the next two dot pictures for a sequence and label the added row, column, and shared corner.
